title: Ibragimov's central limit conjecture for $\phi$-mixing sequences
exact_target: Does every centered stationary phi-mixing sequence with finite second moment and diverging partial-sum variance satisfy the variance-normalized central limit theorem?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10100012 (AMR-100-0012). CC BY 4.0.

R. C. Bradley, \emph{Basic Properties of Strong Mixing Conditions. A Survey and Some Open Questions}, Probability Surveys 2 (2005), pp. 107--144, Section 2.3 (Ibragimov conjecture), and definitions (1.2), (2.2).
